title: Zigzag antiferromagnetic property of two-dimensional NiPX3 (X = S/Se) monolayers in their pristine structure and Janus phase
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,23115-23123
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02861B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Juntao Yang, XuLi Zhang, Zecheng Qu, Qing Min, Jian Xia, Hao Shang, Shijun Luo, Chengrui Wu
The zigzag antiferromagnetic ordering is dominated by super exchange interactions through p–d hybridization, while the coexistence of ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic couplings are facilitated through a combination of antibonding and bonding states.
